component.name: listBlobs
component.description: Gets the list of all blobs.

component.name: uploadBlob
component.description: Uploads the blob into the Azure storage.

component.name: deleteBlob
component.description: Deletes the blob from the Azure storage.

component.name: downloadBlob
component.description: Downloads the blob from the Azure storage.

component.name: blobStreamRead
component.description: Opens an Azure blob as the head of a stream sequence. Only valid inside a streamSequence.

component.name: blobStreamWrite
component.description: Streams a byte chain into an Azure block blob. A stream sequence sink: chunked, resumable, and the blob appears only when the transfer succeeds.
